name: Warm Shrimp Salad with Mixed Veggies, Avocado & Lemon Caper Dressing

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spring mix if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ pints grape tomatoes
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)
1 ½ small bunches green onions (scallions)
1 ½ small bunches Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals (if using fresh shrimp, skip this step). Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Juice the lemon into the medium bowl. Shave leaves off the parsley stems; discard the stems, mince the leaves and add to the bowl.
Finely chop the anchovy fillets, add to the bowl with lemon and parsley. Add mayo, capers, Dijon, and salt; whisk to combine dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 anchovy fillets, packed in oil
¾ cup mayonnaise
3 tbsp capers
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Halve the grape tomatoes. Trim off and discard the root ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle and set aside.
Halve the sugar snap peas at an angle. Trim off and discard the ends of the zucchinis; halve the zucchinis lengthwise, then cut the halves crosswise into ¼-inch-thick half-rounds.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince or press the garlic.

Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add snap peas and zucchini to pan and season with salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, about 2-4 minutes. Once cooked remove veggies from skillet and place skillet back on heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp virgin coconut oil
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Add more oil to the skillet. Add shrimp in an even layer, add garlic and season with salt and pepper. Cook for 2 minutes each side until cooked through and slightly golden. Once cooked, set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp virgin coconut oil
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place salad leaves on the plate, top with shrimp, tomatoes, and sautéed vegetables. Drizzle dressing over top and sprinkle with green onions. Serve warm and enjoy!
